dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Ho there, come and have a look. Each item here is a treasure you shall find in few other places!

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Interested, are we? Well then, allow me to tell you a little something—

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Look at this porcelain bottle, if you will. It may look plain, but it is a true relic, perhaps worth as much as half of Chihu Rock!

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: And this censer — legend has it that it has offered incense to Rex Lapis himself for a thousand years, and has become filled with adeptal energy in the process!

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: And have I mentioned this teapot? Why, it was once used by Rex Lapis himself. You will never find another like it...

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Sure. Come again if you have time to spare, and I'll spin you another yarn!

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: How much? Oh no, I never said I was selling. In fact, you couldn't make me sell these.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what's with the shop if you're not selling?

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Ha, that's a good one. Whoever said that a shop must needs hawk wares?

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: I bought this store here precisely to show these beauties off to any who would pass by.

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Every day, some ignorant bystanders like you will come by and ask me these questions. That said, this is precisely what I want...
